graph.name: Try screenplay formatting
graph.description:
Propose screenplay formatting for an existing reply using a supplied structural template.

Lesson: Data requiredContent checks exact source strings before a model recast; template structure adds no missing story facts.

Limitations: Format Transfer uses a model even with a Data template. Missing content should remain absent; there is no zero-call general prose-to-screenplay converter.

Opening installs an unassigned copy. Bind local model roles and provide the documented evidence before running.

Post: at most 1 auxiliary calls. Preview before publishing or applying.

Try changing:
Use a separate uppercase speaker line in layout while preserving the spoken words.
Remove kitchen from a test source and inspect the requiredContent failure before any request.

Documentation specimen (does not seed chat or actor memory):

Before: At night in the kitchen, Mira closes the door. "They're here," she says.

After: INT. KITCHEN — NIGHT
Mira closes the door.
MIRA: They're here.

Explicit Text-to-Data path: template → decode → format.reference; reply.out → format.in; format → validate → review → apply. One Prose call.

Reference data, not controls: layout/rules and missing-field policy are editorial Data/text. requiredContent is the supported exact check. Revise source-specific required strings with the fixture.

Kitchen scene · prose source (reply)
Purpose: Freeze the latest completed text-only kitchen scene.
Fixture: At night in the kitchen, Mira closes the door. "They're here," she says.
Inspect: Confirm night, kitchen, Mira, closing action and They're here.

Kitchen screenplay template · JSON (template)
Purpose: Supply raw screenplay-reference JSON.
Inspect: No fences; bracket labels describe slots and must not appear in output.

Check screenplay reference shape (decode)
Purpose: Parse and shape-check the format Data.
Inspect: Inspect layout/rules/requiredContent; source matching happens at Format Transfer.

Recast as kitchen screenplay (format)
Purpose: Reorganize supplied prose as screenplay.
Inspect: Expect heading, closing action and MIRA: They're here; no arrival.

Check screenplay source binding (validate)
Purpose: Validate screenplay source binding.
Inspect: Check protected speech and source-bound whole-scope patches.

Review four scene facts (review)
Purpose: Require review of four scene facts.
Inspect: Check kitchen/night, Mira, closing door and unchanged spoken words.

Offer screenplay-formatted scene (apply)
Purpose: Offer screenplay-formatted scene.
Inspect: Full root Host result: compare scene facts, then Apply or Reject.

sections.text: {"layout":"INT. KITCHEN — NIGHT\n[action in present tense]\nMIRA: [supplied dialogue]","rules":["Keep supplied action/speech; normalize heading/speaker casing.","Omit absent fields; invent no location, time, speaker or action."],"requiredContent":["night","kitchen","Mira","closes the door","They're here"]}

format.title: Format Transfer
format.instructions: Use one heading, present-tense action and MIRA: speech. Preserve They're here and closing door. Omit unknown fields; add no arrival, camera direction, stage business or speaker.
